_readme: First read of Santa Monica College's program maps (S336, SkyCourier). The registry records SMC's sequence source as open: its own Program Maps page (www.smc.edu/academics/classes/program-maps.php), which answered in probe run 37209313523 after timing out earlier on 2026-10-04. No pilot college publishes a readable term sequence (Miramar's mapper refuses the reader), so this read learns how SMC publishes a map and which programs have one, before a program is picked for the first term-by-term record. SMC's articulated CPL in MAP sits in Barbering (A.S. 43767: 23 of 25 listed courses carry CPL), Cosmetology (A.S. 03302: 17 of 27), Esthetician and Nail Care; the follow pattern reads those maps if the index links them.

questions.map_index: How SMC publishes its program maps: one page or PDF per program, grouped how, and which programs have one.
questions.map_shape: How one SMC map names its terms and lists its courses, read on the Barbering or Cosmetology map.
